                  Public Utility Commission of Texas

                                    Memorandum


 TO:           Interested Persons

 FROM:         Jessie Horn, Sr. Counsel, Rules and Projects Division

 DATE:         December 16, 2025

 RE:           Project No. 58481, Rulemaking to Implement Large Load Interconnection
               Standards Under PURA §37.0561
               Notice of Workshop


                                    Workshop Details
                                     January 9, 2026
                                      9:30 a.m. CST
                           Barbara Jordan State Office Building
                           1601 Congress Avenue, Room 2.035
                                   Austin, Texas 78701

Commission Staff will host a workshop on January 9, 2026, beginning at 9:30 a.m. CST to
receive public input on topics related to the rulemaking to implement large load
interconnection standards under Public Utility Regulatory Act (PURA) §37.0561. The
workshop will also be broadcast live and archived for later viewing on Admin Monitor. An
agenda will be filed closer to the date of the workshop.
